summary: This study compares gradually lowering the dose versus stopping a weight-loss drug called semaglutide all at once. Researchers want to see how each method affects body weight after people have weight-loss surgery. The trial has a status of Not yet recruiting and plans to include 100 participants. General Committee of Teaching Hospitals and Institutes, Egypt is the sponsor for this Phase 4 study.
